title: Curated usage ledger line
description: One line of <store>/usage.jsonl, the curated store's append-only usage ledger: every view, save, edit, forget and helped or harmed sighting of a memory, by name; the index ranks memories by it. Source: memory/curated/store.go (usageLine, appendUsage, Usage, the Event constants).

quote.description: A helped or harmed event's evidence, the user's words a forget retired the memory on, or the user's words a released event restated a held memory with.

user.description: A helped, forget or released event whose quote is a user's words.

record.description: The record a corrected, cited or promoted event names.

session.description: The session of a staging (the save or staged event of a staged memory) or of a forget-staged event, which hides the memory in that session only, or of a released event, which shows a held memory (one that weakens security, contracts/insecure.md) in that session only.

source.description: A staging's source digest: sha256 hex of the tool output its quote comes from, whitespace collapsed (curated.SourceDigest); two sessions' stagings are independent evidence only when their digests differ.
